answer: Each identity needs three endorsements on the nebula index, with a canyon gap: no shared members or history. A cluster costs 300 (30 interactions, 10 credits each); it endorses at most four per epoch, each endorsement locking 30 credits, refundable on survival. The k-th fake costs 90 locked plus a 300 cluster on quota exhaustion; 1,000 fakes need 750 clusters: 225,000 burned plus 90,000 locked, quotas unmergeable. A spiral audit catches a rented-cluster ring when shared history closes the canyon gap, voiding endorsements and slashing stakes. An honest agent pays 90 refundable credits once.
